outOfScope: A new QA judgment or publication authority
General autonomous visual design grading, accessibility certification and arbitrary browser automation
Changing accepted BB-054/069 contracts or declaring live feature delivery from fixture tests
constraints: RESEARCH_SA discovery only. The plan is DRAFT; product source changes require an exact independently READY plan and delivered direct dependencies.
Generic command checks and injected verifiers already exist. Package the named local profile without replacing product authority or claiming generic checks are incapable of browser/API testing.
Repository metadata and primary reports motivate prototypes; no benchmark score, saved effort or new capability is claimed from a source survey.
Public OSS examples require at least 1000 GitHub stars at lookup. Pin release/source, inspect relevant implementation/tests and reproduce the seam before adoption.
Keep the two Blackboard boundaries distinct: this graph routes ExHarness development; new profiles execute within the product/runtime boundary.
invariants: The independently pinned candidate, environment, evaluator and criterion identities bind each observation; missing or drifted evidence never grants acceptance.
Adapters return observations and criterion facts through existing QA authority; startup, traces and model claims cannot self-publish product acceptance.
Only owned test resources may be reset or disposed; untrusted configuration cannot silently grant commands, credentials or production effects.
architectureDecisions: Compare a deterministic Playwright Test runner with a constrained exploratory browser observer. Start with operator-owned executable journeys; model exploration may propose findings but cannot silently alter acceptance.

Adapt results into the existing criterionVerifier interface and retain local trace/DOM/network evidence. Screenshot presence is not a behavioral assertion and browser traffic can contain sensitive data.
Consume BB-127 protected evaluator content and BB-131 preview receipts. BB-054 keeps exact acceptance/publication authority; the runner supplies criterion evidence only.
implementationSlices: S1: Research and execute the discriminating prototype; ratify the exact local profile, compatibility boundary and external runner selection before READY.
S2: After delivered direct dependencies and fresh READY, implement the named adapter and focused criterion/negative fixtures without changing existing authority.
S3: Reproduce from fresh state, retain subject-bound evidence and reconcile Living documentation before Worker judgment.

livingDocs.statement: Describe the delivered profile, exact identity binding, supported environment and limitations after Worker delivery, without roadmap status or Blackboard ids.

valueHypothesis.expectedValue: Give a reviewer evidence that the feature works through its user workflow, including interactions missed by build-only checks.
valueHypothesis.measurement: Compare build/health-only checks with independent browser journeys on correct, inert-submit, stale-list and missing-persistence fixtures. Predeclare the seeded defect matrix; record missed criteria, false accepts, setup failures and review steps. No live model is needed for calibration.
valueHypothesis.valueOwner: BB-074 owns human-effort/value claims; BB-099 owns supervised/direct agent comparison
valueHypothesis.goNoGo: Advance only if the prototype enables the stated capability, correctly rejects every declared seeded violation and has explicit support/setup limits. Otherwise narrow the profile or KEEP_BASELINE; no default promotion from the source survey.
